subject.title: [Bug]: node approval can dispatch after caller timeout

question: Should Gateway request cancellation become an additive, connection-bound protocol capability with server-owned pending, effecting, and completed states?
rationale: The defect is proven, but cancellation authority, cross-connection rejection, allow-versus-cancel ordering, and post-dispatch semantics define a security-sensitive public protocol contract.

options.title: Add negotiated cancellation
options.body: Advertise capability support, bind cancellation to the originating connection, expire pending approvals, and reject cancellation once dispatch begins.

options.title: Use server deadline only
options.body: Add a server-side deadline without fully representing explicit caller abort and connection-disconnect semantics.

recommendation.title: Add negotiated cancellation
recommendation.body: Advertise capability support, bind cancellation to the originating connection, expire pending approvals, and reject cancellation once dispatch begins.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete, and his Gateway lifecycle and approval-routing history makes him the clearest coordinator for the security-owner decision.
